question: Find and list the names of sets which doesn't have Japanese translation but have Korean translation.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "set_translations" AS SELECT "id" AS "id", "language" AS "language", "set_info" AS "set_info" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT
        language,
        regexp_extract(set_info, '^([^|]+)\|', 1) AS set_code,
        regexp_extract(set_info, '\|(.*)$', 1) AS set_name
    FROM set_translations
    WHERE set_info IS NOT NULL AND set_info LIKE '%|%'
),
codes AS (
    SELECT set_code
    FROM parsed
    GROUP BY set_code
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN language = 'Korean' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
       AND SUM(CASE WHEN language = 'Japanese' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
),
names AS (
    SELECT
        c.set_code,
        COALESCE(
            MAX(CASE WHEN p.language = 'English' THEN p.set_name END),
            MAX(CASE WHEN p.language = 'Korean' THEN p.set_name END),
            c.set_code
        ) AS set_name
    FROM codes c
    LEFT JOIN parsed p ON p.set_code = c.set_code
    GROUP BY c.set_code
)
SELECT set_name
FROM names
ORDER BY set_name
LIMIT 10;
